capabilityRows.notes: ScaleDown 3.0.1: native Decision V4 choice, boolean and score, plus Extraction V4 text/list<text>. x-api-key and SCALEDOWN_API_KEY, lazy async credentials, custom base URL/headers, PDF/JPEG/PNG/TIFF evidence, confidence/legend/cost metadata, strict response validation, UTF-8 byte offsets converted to verified UTF-16 sources and OCR file citations. Other extraction fields and model families are explicitly rejected; JS workflow serialization is outside Swift.

lock.name: @ai-sdk/scaledown
lock.contractReview: All published portable Decision and Extraction provider runtime, request/response schemas and exact-release upstream scenarios reviewed and translated. JavaScript workflow serialization is excluded; Swift dictionary order and integral usage counts follow native contracts. No live-service verification.

release.notes: Add ScaleDown Decision and Extraction V4 APIs. Classify choices, booleans and scores; extract nullable text/list fields with confidence, UTF-16 source offsets and OCR file references. Supports lazy static/async/environment API keys, custom endpoints/headers, document inputs, upstream warnings and structured errors. All portable matching-release 3.0.1 upstream scenarios translated; JavaScript workflow serialization excluded. No paid/live checks.
release.compatibility: Initial independent SwiftPM unit. Requires core 1.4.0; no changes to existing selectors. Provider-only release does not require umbrella release.

verification.note: First compile and run passed. All parameter rows in translated score/error tests ran. No live provider calls.
